task: ae.net.ResilientHttp: HttpClient wrapper with idempotency-aware retries, Retry-After, backoff and delay budget, tested against in-process HttpServer
reasoning_summary: Wrapped HttpClient with a RetryPolicy record, injectable Sleeper and pure-function backoff so delays are asserted without sleeping. Retries are limited to idempotent methods or POSTs with Idempotency-Key; Retry-After (integer seconds, capped) overrides backoff and a total-delay budget stops retrying. First run failed because suppressed exceptions were chained nested instead of flat; fixed by collecting earlier failures and attaching them to the final one.
